_comment: Rows of harness/captures/out2/part_database.json excluded from the capture.part_database gate, one by one, each with its reason (README "Golden gate options", STATUS.md WP-06). Only data that a package other than the module host produces belongs here. Grouped by module class: ModuleDeployableSolarPanel x 9 parts x (originalRotation, currentRotation) = 18 rows. Besides this list the gate drops the 5 code-built prefab parts (tests/CMakeLists.txt DROP_ROWS).

module_fields.reason: the pivot transform's rotation lives in the part's .mu model hierarchy (UE import pipeline / PartTools reader), not in GameData cfg data; parts whose pivot is absent keep the Quaternion default (0,0,0,0) and ARE gated
module_fields.decompiled: ModuleDeployablePart.cs:542-552 (OnAwake: panelRotationTransform = part.FindModelTransform(pivotName); originalRotation = currentRotation = localRotation)
